name: alsiraat-almustaqeem
description: AlSiraatAlMustaqeem — a detective-style Quran study app (React SPA + TypeScript API).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w app"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w app && npm run typecheck -w @alsiraat/mcp
scripts.start: npm run build -w app && npm run start:static -w server
